note: Frozen native-derived human battle idle: EQUIP_WAIT / TYPE_NORMAL row 0 / direction UP / settled post-direction-update state / SEB frame 0. Every value here is read from the intact original SEB and the original tables; nothing is fitted, estimated or taken from a screenshot. This is one frozen idle state, not the complete human animation (walk, attack, hit, knock-down and the runtime-supplied lines are outside this data).

seb.serialization: 4-byte global header, then one 4-byte header plus N x 20-byte key records per line; the walk ends exactly at byte 980. The extracted tmp/KA_assets and api-server copies are 976-byte prefixes that drop the last record of line 13, so they are NOT the source of this data.

resolution.rule: frontImgIds[line] = SEB record texId >= 0 ? imgIds[texId] : texId; the line draws imgIds value as an image index inside that line's own resource group
resolution.note: The battle setup rewrites imgIds[11] (weapon) and imgIds[12] (shield) and forces imgIds[3] = -2, then calls SetHumanImgs 0x165EA88. Reading each line's SEB texId as the imgIds slot reproduces all fifteen line/image pairs of the two frozen demo inputs, including the Armory-missing shield (Archer imgIds[12] = -2) and the forced shoes skip (imgIds[3] = -2). The alternative reading - an IMG_TABLE row indexed by line number - matches no recorded HumanResourceSet row for the same pairs, so it is not used. imgIds value -2 skips the line and -1 keeps the SEB's own texId (also -1 on these lines), which is why every line the original leaves to the runtime is not drawn here.

lineResourceGroups.source: HumanResourceSet FRONT_RES_IDS rows (RE-evidence/20260918-battle-visual-replay/human-native-recovery/HUMAN-RESOURCE-TABLES.json); the row whose line order matches the frozen frame-0 geometry is [18,25,12,15,19,16,14,17,13,-2,-2,-2,25,16]
lineResourceGroups.note: The row pairing of that recovery is SUPPORTED, not CONFIRMED. Only lines 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 12 and 13 reach a draw in this frozen state; their groups (18, 25, 12, 15, 16, 14) are additionally corroborated by the job/equip records, by each group's own img.inf contents and by the crop matching the OPT cell grid.
lineResourceGroups.partDirsNote: Group -> character_sprites directory. Each mapping is fixed by the group's own img.inf: 18 holds only shadow.png at index 0, 25 holds both the shield (index 100) and the weapon (index 270/295) images, 12 body, 15 foot, 16 hand, 14 face, and each drawn SEB crop (u/v/w/h) lands exactly on one cell of that directory's OPT grid (24x30 body/foot/hand/shield/shadow, 24x24 face, 60x60 weapon). Lines 4 and 7-11 are not drawn here, so groups 19 (shoes), 17, 13 and the -2 entries are not resolved.

linesNote: Frame-0 record of every SEB line, in file order. Lines are drawn in ascending line order; reversU/reversV stay 0 because the UP variant is the un-mirrored asset. Lines 1-6, 12 and 13 carry the character's own image through imgIds; lines 7-11 carry texId -1 (the SEB leaves them to the fighter's ImageComponent) and are therefore never drawn by this path.

charactersNote: Both configurations are valid demonstration inputs, not a reproduction of any saved character: they are the job record's default weapon/shield plus the first per-gender appearance entry, with the battle-time imgIds rewrites (weapon, shield, shoes skip) applied. The 17-slot layout and the slot rules are the ones already documented in src/lib/battle-replay.ts (HUMAN_IMAGE_SLOTS).
